thread:
kayla_ae: Hey @omar @jin @sreya — Acme POC is blocked. Their integration keeps returning 401 'invalid_api_key' after we provisioned the key. Customer says the key shows up in the Console under their org. Can someone help? (customer: Maria @acme)

omar_se: hi kayla — can you paste the exact request + response (headers) they're sending? the key id would help too.

maria_acme: sharing the curl from their engineer:
```
curl -v \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_12345\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
response body: `{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"key org/project mismatch"}`
response headers: `x-request-id: req_abc`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 59`

jin_support: thanks. quick checks: are they using a project-scoped key against an endpoint that expects org-scoped keys? we introduced `x-redwood-project` header for project routing; if omitted, default org routing applies.

can you run this to inspect the key metadata?
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_12345\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/inspect
```
expected response example: `{"id":"sk_live_12345","scope":"project","project":"acme-poc","org":"acme-corp"}`

maria_acme: we ran that and got the same output — scope is `project` and project is `acme-poc`.

omar_se: OK likely cause: the POC server either omits the project header or routes to a deployment bound to a different project/org. if the key is project-scoped but the target deployment is pinned to another project, you'll get that mismatch.

jin_support: Workarounds: 1) create an org-scoped key in the Console (Console > API Keys > New Key (Org)) OR 2) add header `x-redwood-project: acme-poc` to the request OR 3) rebind the deployment to `acme-poc`. #2 is fastest for a quick test.

maria_acme: added header `x-redwood-project: acme-poc` — now getting 429 with body `{'error':'rate_limit_exceeded'}` and header `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`.

jin_support: looks like they hit their POC quota / burst limit on the Dedicated pool. i can provision a temporary bump. i'll open a support ticket to add +5 RPS for `acme-poc` for 24h. can you share approximate request timestamps so i can correlate logs?

kayla_ae: Ticket created: INC-2026. jin assigned. Maria, can we do a quick call at 11:30 PT today to validate keys, header, and quota live?

maria_acme: :thumbsup: 11:30 PT works for us. thanks.

jin_support: provisioning a temporary org-scoped test key and bumping quota now. i'll post the new key here once ready.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: key-provisioner v2.1.3 — 1792001250

jin_support: new test key (rotated after demo): `sk_test_temp_67890`. please use only for the demo and delete afterwards. note: required scopes for generation are `inference:generate`. embeddings need `inference:embed`. do NOT use org-scoped keys in production without approval.

sreya_security: adding to security tracker: confirm key audit logs show only test usage, then we will rotate. Maria — can you share your security contact for the questionnaire (KMS, audit retention, SOC items)?

maria_acme: Sasha (sasha@acme.com). i'll email the questionnaire answers after the demo.

kayla_ae: closing the immediate loop — jin/omar to follow up on quota bump and key rotation. i'll update deal notes and summary for the customer. :white_check_mark:
